candidateJsonMustNotCreateByItself: TRACE projection edges with endpoints absent from the candidate row

CANONICAL_ASSERTION_CANDIDATE.definition: An exact occurrence in the frozen candidate JSON that may be preserved as a proposed, source-bound assertion or legacy crosswalk. It is not an accepted claim or semantic relation.
CANONICAL_ASSERTION_CANDIDATE.promotion: provenance.assertion acceptance=proposed; accepted assignment/relation requires independent evidence and curator decision

COMPUTED_ASSOCIATION.definition: An analytical TRACE occurrence. It remains non-promotable until an analysis run records method/software version, parameters, exact input release/corpus hashes, score/unit/uncertainty/threshold, and output hash.
COMPUTED_ASSOCIATION.promotion: held from canonical acceptance and release projection until the computed-association contract is satisfied

HELD_UNSUPPORTED.definition: An occurrence with unknown predicate, missing required evidence, review-only authority, unsupported parent lineage, malformed structure, or no approved registry mapping.
HELD_UNSUPPORTED.promotion: workflow queue only; creates no semantic relation, TRACE projection, publication row, or metric row

LEGACY_PROJECTION_ONLY.definition: A frozen v48 graph/read-product occurrence preserved for reconciliation, citation, and visual recovery but not authorized as v49 canonical research data.

REJECTED.definition: An occurrence covered by an explicit evidence-bearing rejection decision. Absence, unfamiliarity, low confidence, or a blank field does not silently imply rejection.
REJECTED.promotion: preserve decision and provenance; no active projection

failClosedPolicy.unknownRelationAction: preserve literal as a proposed raw assertion and queue review

hashRecipe.rowFormat: compact JSON array with ensure_ascii=false followed by LF

legacyFailOpenPaths.behavior: Any label outside the hard-coded provenance/time/place/influence sets is returned as medium_context.
Any label absent from TRACE_TYPE_BY_ID receives MC-OTHER, family medium_context, and status documented.
A blank candidate trace.tier is derived as source_verified whenever objectNodeId, edgeCount, and an HTTP(S) evidence-return URL satisfy the builder's accepted test.

rulePriority.condition: an explicit evidence-bearing rejection decision identifies this exact occurrence
predicate is absent from the approved registry, structure is malformed, required evidence is missing, or authority depends on an unapproved parent
registered label is analytical; canonical/release promotion remains blocked unless complete analysis-run provenance exists
exact field occurrence is present in the frozen candidate JSON and maps to a registered non-analytical predicate or a typed legacy crosswalk
occurrence exists only in immutable SQLite, TRACE manifest/assets, atlas/catalog/shards, or another derived product

candidate_branch_reference.semanticLimit: legacy placement crosswalk only; does not define a v49 branch or relation

candidate_trace_edge_reference.semanticLimit: opaque legacy edge crosswalk only; candidate JSON does not contain the complete directed edge endpoint/evidence row and edgeLabels is not positionally zippable

candidate_trace_edge_to_label_mapping.reason: 9,393 of 15,923 surfaces have different edgeIds and edgeLabels lengths; the arrays do not define an edge-to-predicate mapping

candidate_trace_relation_label_occurrenc.semanticLimit: source-row assertion that a label is present; no endpoint, edgeId, evidence, or semantic-relation identity may be inferred

candidate_trace_state_literal.semanticLimit: source-row workflow/display literal only; accepted or not_inferred does not create an accepted claim, semantic relation, influence finding, corpus membership, or TRACE eligibility

candidate_trace_object_node_reference.semanticLimit: legacy crosswalk only; objectNodeId is not core.entity identity

candidate_tree_membership_reference.semanticLimit: proposed project classification, not historical genealogy

candidate_trace_tier_literal.semanticLimit: tier does not imply research-corpus or TRACE eligibility

sqlite_trace_tier_normalization.semanticLimit: derived source_verified value cannot replace a blank candidate JSON trace.tier or create eligibility

sqlite_review_row.semanticLimit: review reconciliation population; cannot create an archive object from SQLite

sqlite_trace_edge_record.semanticLimit: directed v48 triple is a projection identity, never claim or semantic-relation identity

sqlite_trace_node_record.semanticLimit: node type, canonicalKey, label, and layout tree are descriptive projection data

sqlite_tree_identifier.semanticLimit: tree presence is organizational projection data; active candidate membership is accounted separately

v47_auxiliary_input_fact.semanticLimit: v47 parent/adjunct facts require independent governed evidence before v49 ingest
